name: Forge Rat
description:
You've spent a lot of time hanging around the public forges of Highlake, and you've picked up a flair for experimentation.

Once per Intermezzo, if you have access to a forge and do not already have a Difficulty set for this ability, you may spend at least one day modifying a weapon or piece of armor you own, choosing one of the following effects:

  • The item grants +1 Defense.

  • One of the item's damage dice increases or decreases by 1 die type.

  • One of the item's engagement dice increases or decreases by 1 die type.

Roll Craft to set the Difficulty. Whenever you're targeted by an attack roll that is against your Defense, if the roll result is greater than or equal to the Difficulty, your modified item is broken. Clear the Difficulty.

If after five such tests the item has not broken, the modification becomes permanent. Clear the Difficulty. You may modify the same item a maximum of two times.

Describe your modifications.
